premise_typing: P000 six-dimensional discrete Cell space is assumed
the FCC object is the selected classical coordinate carrier, not the native identity
the four close-packed slice normals and six line families are carrier/readout data
the standard spherical-area interpretation is separated from the exact rational/quaternion core

theorems.name: Regular tetrahedral slice-normal frame
theorems.statement: The four FCC slice normals have square norm 3, pairwise dot product -1, and total sum zero.

theorems.name: Cross-normal recovery of the six FCC line families
theorems.statement: ell_ST=(n_S x n_T)/2 has square norm 2, ell_TS=-ell_ST, and the six unordered pairs reproduce L1,...,L6 up to unoriented sign.

theorems.name: Canonical local 120-degree charts
theorems.statement: For each slice S, the three outgoing ell_ST sum to zero and have pairwise dot product -1 and equal square norm 2.

theorems.name: Scalar orientation frustration
theorems.statement: No assignment of vertex signs can make all shared oriented lines agree; the product of natural overlap signs around every triangle is -1.

theorems.name: Exact proper inter-slice transport
theorems.statement: T_ST(v)=(-v+2 ell(ell dot v)+2 ell x v)/3 fixes ell_ST, maps n_S to n_T, preserves the dot form, and has inverse T_TS.

theorems.name: Covariant transport of local complex structures
theorems.statement: T_ST(n_S x v)=n_T x T_ST(v); equivalently the normalized spin rotor Q_ST=(1+ell_ST)/sqrt(3) conjugates J_S=n_S/sqrt(3) to J_T.

theorems.name: Tetrahedral triangular spin holonomy
theorems.statement: For distinct S,T,U, Q_US Q_TU Q_ST = epsilon_STU J_S with epsilon_STU=det(n_S,n_T,n_U)/4 in {+1,-1}; its square is -1.

theorems.name: Euler tangent half-turn holonomy
theorems.statement: The vector transport around S->T->U->S equals H_S(v)=2 n_S(n_S dot v)/3-v, hence is -I on the starting slice plane.

theorems.name: Spherical face area interpretation
theorems.statement: The normalized four-slice normals form a regular tetrahedron on S^2; its four congruent spherical faces have area pi, and standard parallel-transport holonomy agrees with EMESH-T08.
theorems.boundary: The exact -I holonomy does not depend on importing spherical area or numerical pi.

theorems.name: Cell-radius triple normalization
theorems.statement: The same positive scalar 1/sqrt(3) normalizes the Cell radius, each slice-normal complex element J_S, and every inter-slice spin rotor 1+ell_ST.
theorems.boundary: Carrier/readout normalization; no primitive native length-operator multiplication is asserted.
